newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: A human must open the official first-party Music Submission interface, inspect every live field and control without bypassing cookie, consent, validation or anti-bot mechanisms, confirm international eligibility and all release, file, link, metadata, release-age, explicit-content and AI-origin rules, verify that the selected MarcsMusic release has not already been submitted, and submit manually only if permitted. Stop if CAPTCHA, login, payment, mandatory consent or any platform restriction appears.

deduplication.result: Default-branch repository code search and the complete open pull-request patch were checked for the station name, official domain and canonical homepage route. No previous canonical music-submission-agent record was found. The dedicated first-party Music Submission interface is stored once. General Queries, Volunteering, studio-booking, telephone and other adjacent contact routes were excluded rather than counted as submission opportunities.

notes: The opportunity is publicly authorized and free-first but remains needs_manual_review because the live form fields and controls, detailed delivery requirements and international eligibility are not passively confirmed. No form, cookie choice, email, file, link, login, CAPTCHA, payment or consent was entered, submitted or bypassed.
